Battery.description: Section 2. One of the four batteries, individuated as a distinct resource condition carrying its own charge state and developmental state, not a label. A battery with no charge state is a name, so battery and charge_state are required; developmental state is optional because developmental-state conformance is transparency-based, not threshold-based.

battery.description: Which of the four batteries this is.

charge_state.description: Section 2. The cyclical axis, the battery's currently accessible state.

developmental_state.description: Section 2. The permanent axis, when the organization tracks it, across depth, breadth, and durability.

CheckingPractice.description: Section 7.2. The four conditions that make a battery check genuine rather than theater. Conformance is defined by the quality of the checking practice, not the level it reveals.

adverse_result_integrity.description: A low or declining result is demonstrably received and responded to.

regularity.description: The check happens on a defined cadence, not only when prompted by crisis.

specificity.description: The check produces a result specific enough to be wrong.

structural_embeddedness.description: The check is embedded in coordination activity rather than appended as a separate periodic review.

ConditionStatus.description: Section 8.2. One scope-and-delegation condition and its status, so a condition is never asserted without a present-or-absent determination.

ConformanceAnswer.description: Per-condition answer; silence is not one of the values.

ConformanceDeclaration.description: The conformance answers on the face. There is deliberately no overall or total field: conformance is per-battery at the charge layer plus the checking practice and the scope conditions, mirroring the suite's refusal to collapse a profile into a single number. The developmental-state axis is transparency-based and is not a conformance threshold.
ConformanceDeclaration.title: ConformanceDeclaration

DevelopmentalState.description: Section 2. The developmental state of a battery across its three mutually constituting dimensions. Transformed by integration events, not restored by recovery; declared and tracked rather than required at a level.

breadth.description: The inclusivity of the frame, how many distinct perspectives it can hold simultaneously without collapsing to a dominant one.

depth.description: Precision of interpretive capacity, built through transclusion events that move a prior position from ceiling to floor.

durability.description: The persistence of developmental state under conditions that would reverse or suppress it.

DevelopmentalState.title: DevelopmentalState
